issues.text: demo.html, 390x844 and 320x568, every language (ru, kk, en), both themes: the fixed phone bar aside#ticket.ticket (position fixed, bottom 0; css/site.css lines about 1744-1755 in the max-width 759px block) lies over the footer navigation links of the page when the page is scrolled to its end, so the links «Главная», «Как это работает», «Демо-опрос» and «Примеры запросов» cannot be tapped (the page cannot scroll further: scrollHeight 1070 at 390, 1060 at 320; the bar covers y 759-844 at 390 and 483-568 at 320, the links stand at y 736-832 at 390 and 459-555 at 320; elementFromPoint at the middle of each link returns the bar). Found by LD-1 (REQ-111 criterion 12, 'no control over another', decisions/0124 O18; its rule 'covered': every control is scrolled to the middle of the window and the element at its middle point must be the control). Not the first-screen overlap of «Не знаю» that decisions/0123 I8 accepts: this is the end of the page. Evidence: LD-1 in three runs in a row, same findings; screenshots <scratch>/t4/x/demo-bottom-390.png and <scratch>/t4/x/demo-bottom-320.png (page scrolled to its end); with one rule appended to site.css in a scratch copy (padding-bottom 160px under the footer below 760 px) LD-1 is green and all 15 tests are green three times (the planted copy L1m). The test stays strict; the fix is CODE-FIXER's (space under the footer for the bar, or no bar over the footer), then steps 3 and 4 again; the demo's look at phone width goes on the owner's list for G21 anyway (decisions/0124 O19).

The task text names ST-1..ST-5; the design (section 10, section 9 row REQ-112/6, the counts 'e2e 15 (LD 9, ST 6)') has ST-1..ST-6, ST-6 being the requests, console and CSP rule of REQ-112 criterion 6. All six are written; NPM-7 counts 15.
REQ-111 criterion 11 names the e2e presence guard as 'e2e: landing' only; the design (section 11 row 2) and NPM-7 name landing and stage (and the 15 ids). For DOC-UPDATER at the release step.

Links carry no ?lang=: a visitor who arrives at /demo.html?lang=en and taps «Описать идею» lands on how.html in Russian, unless the language was chosen with the button (then sai-lang is stored and the next page follows it). By design (PP-3 reads addresses without query; the language is stored only by the button), no criterion names it, so it is no defect; the tests store the language as a visitor's click does before they follow the link. For DESIGN-QA and ORCH.

The hidden tab: a headless Chrome tab never leaves the foreground (document.hidden stays false when another tab is brought to the front, measured), so ST-3 sets document.hidden in the page and fires visibilitychange, which is the page's own path (view.js reads doc.hidden and listens to that event). The mutant of M56 that removes the check only in the frame callback is equivalent (T3 I3: the visibility handler cancels the pending frame); the e2e mutant S3a removes all three checks and is red.

Measured, not defects: the whole e2e run takes about 6.4-6.7 min on this machine (the design's budget in section 8 says 6 min for the Mac; the e2e job limit is 20 min); LD-7 holds a request 8 s twice (the page's DEMO_TIMEOUT_MS), ST-2 walks about 100 s. Every wait is a condition with a deadline or a count of the page's own frames; no test reads the clock for a decision.

One Chrome launch hung for the 180 s default of playwright-core in the first of the three tree runs on the files before the retry (while three mutant runs and another e2e run were going at once; the other 14 tests passed). openBrowser (T1's helper, app/test/fixtures/browser.js, in this sub-step's write set) now makes up to three launches of 30 s each and retries only a TimeoutError; a machine without Chrome still fails at once with the message of playwright-core, never a skipped test. The final three runs of both copies were made on the final files.

The kk language is read on the local set only (LD-1, LD-2, LD-3, LD-4, LD-6, ST-1, ST-2, ST-3, ST-5); the public set (LD-9) is ru and en, with ?lang=kk read in Russian. Q8, Q9, Q11 and R3 are not touched by this sub-step (no tenant data, no SQL, no address read, no photo); Q10 is LD-7 and ST-5.
